"""design_D568 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성·분할 생성 (학습/성능 계산 없음).
설계서와 다른 잠정 처리(확인 필요):
  - cr_last: collect_time 대신 report_time <= 퇴원으로 제한 (퇴원 후 보고 결과 누출 방지)
  - dx_*, n_dx: 색인 입원의 진단만 사용 (다른/미래 입원 진단 혼입 방지)
  - 분할 키: family_id(없으면 patient_id) 기준 그룹 홀드아웃
  - 데이터 종료 30일 이내 퇴원은 censored_followup 플래그로 표시 (제외 여부 확인 필요)
"""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = ROOT / "data"
OUT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.loads((ROOT / "design_D568.json").read_text())

P = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
A = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
L = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
O = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
DX = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")

A = A.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
A["tp"] = A["discharge_time"]
A["next_admit"] = A.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
A["readmit_30d"] = ((A["next_admit"] > A["tp"]) & (A["next_admit"] <= A["tp"] + pd.Timedelta("30D"))).astype(int)
data_end = max(A["discharge_time"].max(), A["admit_time"].max())
A["censored_followup"] = (A["tp"] + pd.Timedelta("30D") > data_end).astype(int)
A["n_prior_adm"] = A.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()
A["los_h"] = (A["discharge_time"] - A["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600

# 코호트
C = A.merge(P, on="patient_id", how="left")
n0 = len(C)
C = C[C["age"] >= 18]; n1 = len(C)
C = C[C["discharge_status"] != "died"]; n2 = len(C)

win = C[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]]
def lab_agg(test, tcol, agg):
    s = L[L.test == test].merge(win, on="admission_id")
    s = s[(s[tcol] >= s.admit_time) & (s[tcol] <= s.tp)].sort_values(tcol)
    return s.groupby("admission_id")["value"].agg(agg)

C = C.set_index("admission_id")
C["hgb_min"] = lab_agg("hemoglobin", "report_time", "min")
C["cr_last"] = lab_agg("creatinine", "report_time", "last")
o = O[O.order_type == "dialysis_order"].merge(win, on="admission_id")
o = o[(o.order_time >= o.admit_time) & (o.order_time <= o.tp)]
C["dialysis_ordered"] = C.index.isin(o.admission_id).astype(int)
code3 = DX.icd_code.str[:3]
C["dx_ckd"] = C.index.isin(DX.admission_id[code3 == "N18"]).astype(int)
C["dx_chf"] = C.index.isin(DX.admission_id[code3 == "I50"]).astype(int)
C["n_dx"] = DX.groupby("admission_id").size().reindex(C.index).fillna(0).astype(int)
C = C.reset_index()

# 분할 (가족 단위)
C["split_group"] = C["family_id"].fillna(C["patient_id"])
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=design["split"]["test_fraction"], random_state=design["split"]["seed"])
tr, te = next(gss.split(C, groups=C["split_group"]))
C["split"] = "train"; C.loc[C.index[te], "split"] = "test"

feats = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "tp", "split",
        "readmit_30d", "censored_followup"] + feats
C[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv", index=False)

summary = {
    "cohort_flow": {"admissions": n0, "adult": n1, "excl_died": n2},
    "split_n": C["split"].value_counts().to_dict(),
    "outcome_rate_by_split": C.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "outcome_by_discharge_status": C.groupby("discharge_status")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict(),
    "outcome_by_unit": C.groupby("unit")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]).round(4).to_dict(),
    "censored_followup_n": int(C["censored_followup"].sum()),
    "missing_rate": C[feats].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
    "group_overlap_patient": len(set(C.patient_id[C.split == "train"]) & set(C.patient_id[C.split == "test"])),
    "group_overlap_family": len(set(C.family_id[C.split == "train"].dropna()) & set(C.family_id[C.split == "test"].dropna())),
}
(OUT / "prep_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
EOF
